results.caption:
Retinol does NOT have to be an extreme sport 😭 #OlayPartner If you’ve been wanting to add retinol to your routine but didn’t know where to start, the @olay Retinol24 Starter was made with first-time retinol users in mind. It’s their gentlest retinol formula and a great place to start before working your way up the Retinol24 lineup.

What’s your biggest skincare goal right now? Tell me below 👀✨

#RetinolReveal #SkincareRoutine #RetinolRoutine

results.transcript: Take this from someone who's been using retinol for like 10 years. It does not have to be an extreme sport. Why would you not crawl before you walk? You don't just jump straight into it. It's okay to practice skincare in steps just like you would anything else. Olay, I'm so excited to be partnering with you guys again. When Olay sent me this product, I immediately knew who the target demographic was. Someone who is newly incorporating a retinol in their skincare routine, doesn't wanna overload their skin, doesn't wanna do too much, but still wants the active ingredients and benefits of regularly incorporating a retinol. This is one of the newest retinols to my routine. I was already a fan of this line from Olay, but now that they came out with this retinol 24 starter, they low key might have snapped. I have melanated skin, so I will pretty much always have a retinol in my skincare routine. If you don't know where else to start, start here. I don't know if you saw how fast that absorbed, but I literally just used two pumps and patted that in and it immediately soaked into my skin. And it's also fragrance free, which I think retinol should be fragrance free. That's one of the few exceptions I'll make. The retinol 24 night cream is also a fan favorite in this household. So if you start feeling a little bit more comfortable, if you are loving the way that your skin is responding over time, then you can work your way up. In my opinion, that is one of the best skincare approaches you can take when you're trying to transform your skin. Slow and steady wins the race. You don't have to believe me, but you can look at them exactly. Olay, thank you for this. You did your big one for the texture girlies, the dark spot girlies, and the girls who want to overall improve the quality of their skin. I'm going to bed. Y'all be quiet on the creek and I'll see y'all in the next video. Bye.
